Mandarin tone perception by cochlear implant listeners is influenced by the relative weighting of loudness and pitch contours in the stimulus.
Mandarin tone perception in CI listeners can be based on either pitch-contour or loudnesscontour, depending on the individual CI user.

(1) CI users can use either pitch contour or loudness contour to identify tone in Mandarin, and (2) CI users’ tone perception is more affected by loudness-contour manipulation than NH subjects’ tone perception is.

the question of how the auditory system processes the pitch and loudness contour in Mandarin tone perception, and how it relates to the auditory processing of speech in general.
